subject: Kickoff: Renewal & Expansion MAP — Skyward Tech (usage review and upsell plan)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@skywardtech.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@skywardtech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Renewal & Expansion MAP — Skyward Tech (usage review and upsell plan)

Hi Ayesha / Liam —

Thanks again for the great conversation on the renewal options. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a simple Mutual Action Plan to align timelines, owners, and the evaluation items we agreed on for the renewal + expansion. High-level goals: confirm renewal terms by end of May, validate the new embeddings workload for Search+Recommendations, and scope an additional ML compute seat for a pilot by July.

Proposed owners and immediate asks:
- Skyward product/ops: Ayesha (primary), Liam (technical) — provide Q1 usage metrics and top-10 prompt families by 3/20
- Redwood: Stephanie (renewal owner), Marcus (SE — evaluation / pilot config), Evelyn (CS — onboarding & training)

Attached is a quick Q1 usage export and a first-pass MAP draft (MAP-draft-v1.docx). Can you confirm these owners and the 3/20 data delivery date? If that works I’ll schedule bi-weekly checkpoints and a technical evaluation window (we suggest 3/23–3/27) for Marcus to run the pilot config.

Next steps I’ll take after confirmation:
- Share an editable MAP with milestones and deliverables
- Open a temporary dedicated pilot capacity for the embeddings workload
- Book a 45-minute technical kickoff with Marcus and your data team

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments:
- Q1-usage-report.csv (CSV, 42 KB)
- MAP-draft-v1.docx (DOCX, 84 KB)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@skywardtech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@skywardtech.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal & Expansion MAP — Skyward Tech (usage review and upsell plan)

Stephanie —

Thanks for pulling this together. Owners look good on our side — I’ll own collection of the usage slices (Q1 overall, by product) and Liam will pull the prompt families and a short list of high-cost queries. We can hit the 3/20 target for the data export.

Two clarifying items from our leadership: can you include an expected cost delta for the proposed pilot (estimated GPU hours) and a recommended SLA tier if we enable the expanded real-time embeddings? Also, Liam needs the exact model/quant profiles Marcus plans to test so we can validate compatibility with our infra.

I can do the technical kickoff on 3/24 in the afternoon — does that work for Marcus?

Cheers,
Ayesha Khan
VP Product Operations | Skyward Tech
ayesha.khan@skywardtech.com | +1 (650) 555-0987

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@skywardtech.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal & Expansion MAP — Skyward Tech (usage review and upsell plan)

Ayesha — thanks for the quick reply. Confirming 3/24 afternoon works for me (propose 3/24 1:30pm PT). For the technical pack I’ll send a short compatibility checklist and the exact test matrix by EOD 3/17. High-level pilot plan:

- Models: redwood-embed-large-v2 (quantized) and redwood-text-latency-1 for mixed traffic testing
- Pilot capacity: 2x A10-equivalent GPU seats for 2 weeks (we’ll scale down after initial tuning)
- Expected GPU hours estimate: ~140–200 GPU hours total for the first two-week run — I’ll provide a line-item cost delta in the checklist
- Data needs: top-10 prompt families (from you), representative documents for embedding (S3/Drive link), and a small test harness key we’ll provide

I’ll attach the checklist and the cost estimate — plan to keep this sandboxed and low-risk.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachments:
- tech-compat-checklist.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-17T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Renewal & Expansion MAP — Skyward Tech (usage review and upsell plan)

Looping in a quick commercial note — happy to approve a standard 10% pilot credit for the first two-week seat allocation to reduce friction. Stephanie, if Ayesha confirms the timeline we can reflect the pilot credit and an optional step-up discount in the MAP. Marcus, keep me posted if the estimated GPU hours exceed ~220 so we can re-evaluate.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Thanks team — all set on our end. Ayesha confirmed owners and we’ll deliver the usage CSV and prompt families by 3/20. 3/24 1:30pm PT works for the technical kickoff; I’ll send a calendar invite and include the S3 access pointer for the test documents.

Two quick asks for Marcus before the call:
- Please include the exact model artifact names and quant settings you’ll use (we can pre-validate on our infra)
- A short list of expected performance KPIs we should measure during the pilot (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, embedding similarity recall at k)

Appreciate the pilot credit offer — I’ll flag that as helpful when I brief procurement. Looking forward to the MAP doc.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Staff Engineer | Skyward Tech
liam.oconnor@skywardtech.com
